 Comment 1 1 React Share Holger Rune Reveals Big Ambitions and Takes Roger Federer as His Model
 Despite a long absence caused by his Achilles tendon injury, Holger Rune has lost none of his ambition. The Dane has even found a model in Roger Federer to help him return to the top of the game.
 MURCIA, SPAIN - AUGUST 20: Holger Rune trains alongside Spain's Carlos Alcaraz at Real Sociedad Club De Campo on August 20, 2026 in El Palmar, Murcia, Spain. © CLIVE BRUNSKILL / Getty Images via AFP Jules Hypolite 09/11/2026, 17:37 2 min to read Follow us Federer Rune Stockholm Holger Rune still has big ambitions for the rest of his career.
 As he continues his return to competition after a serious Achilles tendon injury, the Dane has not given up on his goals: becoming world No. 1 and winning Grand Slam titles.
 Remove ads “There are no impossible goals”
 In an interview with SpilXperten, the former world No. 4 spoke about his aspirations, as well as the role model he wants to follow to make his comeback a success: Roger Federer.
 “My goal is without any doubt to become world No. 1 and win Grand Slam tournaments.
 I want to keep improving and become an even stronger player than I was before. These ambitions are an integral part of my journey.
 That's what I want. I don't think there are any impossible goals. Everything is possible.”
 Federer as a source of inspiration
 To get back to his best level, Rune notably studied Roger Federer's path after his return from injury in 2017.
 At the time, the Swiss managed to climb back to the summit of tennis, notably winning two Grand Slam titles within a few months, at the Australian Open and Wimbledon.
 “I took Federer as an example by thinking back to what he managed to achieve after his return from a knee injury, around 2017, when he regained total dominance on the ATP Tour.
 I've thought a lot about that aspect: that's exactly the kind of player I would like to be on my return,” the Dane revealed.
 “Play as many matches as possible before the Australian Open”
 But before reaching the top again, Rune mainly wants to regain his rhythm:
 “For now, the priority is to play as many matches as possible before the Australian Open. So I hope to put in good performances in Stockholm (this week).
 Then I will have to keep working hard to arrive in Australia in the best possible condition.
 It takes a huge amount of work, but my goal is to become the best version of myself.”
